title: Wishes About the Past: Ojalá Hubiera and ¡Quién Hubiera!
goal: Say a wish about the past, something that did not happen, with ojalá or quién + the pluperfect subjunctive.
grammar: Past wishes with ojalá and quién + pluperfect subjunctive

items: I can say a wish about the past with ojalá + hubiera or hubiese + participle.
I can tell a wish about now from a wish about the past: ojalá tuviera, ojalá hubiera tenido.
I can use the new words for longing and regret.
